lines.intro: A fizzy hamster bursts out of the snow with a snowball in each paw!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the hamster?

soothe.great: Fae hums a cozy campfire song. The hamster drops its snowballs!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. The hamster stops to listen.
soothe.miss: The hamster is too busy packing snowballs to hear Fae.

play.great: Maddie pounces on a rolling snowball. The hamster squeaks with joy!
play.good: Maddie bats at the snow. The hamster peeks over its backpack.
play.miss: Maddie sinks into a snowdrift. The hamster giggles a tiny squeak.

cast.great: Sue casts her ribbon bobber across the snow. The hamster scurries after it!
cast.good: Sue's bobber skips over the snow. The hamster's nose twitches.
cast.miss: Sue's bobber gets stuck in a snowbank. The hamster blinks.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles pinecones in a twirling arc. The hamster's whiskers twitch in wonder!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone. The hamster catches it and nibbles thoughtfully.
juggle.miss: A pinecone bounces off Jordan's boot. The hamster puffs its cheeks.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy cracker. The hamster stuffs it in its cheeks!
lines.burst: The hamster whirls and flings a flurry of snowballs at Fae!

burstResult.good: Fae dodges most of the snowballs!
burstResult.miss: Poof! Fae gets a face full of snow.

lines.soothed: The hamster lets out a happy squeak. The fizzy spell melts away!
lines.rest: Fae is too chilly to go on. Time to warm up.
lines.run: Fae tiptoes away through the snow. The hamster keeps whirling.
